meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当你想弄懂某个技术概念时，Claude 会用大白话从五个方面解释：谁、是什么、在哪里、为什么、什么时候。
howto.when: 当你要求用通俗易懂的语言拆解一个技术话题，并想了解它的背景（谁、什么、何处、为何、何时）时触发。

say.text: 用大白话讲一下机器学习：谁在用、是什么、在哪用、为什么用、什么时候用？
say.note: Claude 会按五个 W 拆解回答。

say.text: 我不懂 DNS，请按 who、what、where、why、when 分别解释。
say.note: Claude 将按固定框架说明。

say.text: 这个防火墙技术太专业了，帮我用简单话说清楚五个 W。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a plain-English breakdown of a tech topic, Claude splits it into five parts: who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: This triggers when you want a non-technical explanation of something technical, using the who/what/where/why/when framework.

say_en.text: Explain machine learning in plain language: who, what, where, why, and when?
say_en.note: Claude will structure the answer around the five Ws.

say_en.text: I don't understand DNS. Break it down by who, what, where, why, when.
This firewall tech is too technical. Explain the five Ws in simple words.
